en.headline: Observatory extends Thunderstorm Warning until 1pm
en.dek: The warning issued at 9.40am was prolonged after isolated thunderstorms were forecast over Hong Kong, the Observatory said.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Thunderstorm Warning issued at 9.40am on Sunday would remain in force until 1pm, after it was first set to expire at 11.30am. Isolated thunderstorms were expected over Hong Kong.

In its late-morning bulletin the Observatory said areas of thundery showers continued to develop to the west of the Pearl River Estuary and might affect the territory in the next couple of hours. It advised people outdoors to take shelter, leave the water, and keep away from high ground, trees and conductive objects.

Sunday was forecast to stay mainly cloudy with a few showers and squally thunderstorms, heavier in some areas, and a high of about 31 degrees. Monday was expected to be mainly cloudy with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms.

zh.headline: 天文台將雷暴警告延長至下午1時
zh.dek: 天文台上午9時40分發出的雷暴警告已延長至下午1時，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。
body: 香港天文台表示，周日上午9時40分發出的雷暴警告由原先有效至上午11時30分，延長至下午1時，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。
天文台近午天氣稿指出，珠江口以西仍有雷雨區發展，未來一兩小時可能影響本港。雷暴期間如身處室外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿在戶外游泳或進行水上活動，亦不要站立於高地或接近樹木、桅杆等導電物體。
天文台預料今日大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨及狂風雷暴，部分地區雨勢較大，最高氣溫約31度。周一仍然多雲，間中有驟雨及狂風雷暴。
